big: Nifty Power is a snapshot of one slice of the market. Its factsheet answers four quick questions: how many stocks, what is the valuation, who is on top and how concentrated is it.

lines: What does the Nifty Power track?
Nifty Power aims to track the performance of stocks from the Power sector within the Nifty Total Market. It holds 23 stocks and is rebalanced twice a year.
